patch.value: GH-1563: preserve later peer edits during bulk checkpoint rollback
External report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1563. Revalidate the reported 2026.10.23 behavior against the checkout before implementation.

Rollback reverses only successful batch effects; unrelated peer metadata and annotations remain; drift on batch-modified fields refuses without writes; failed forward rows are never restored; close-many uses the same protection

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Implementation plan: replace timestamp-wide restoration with guarded inverse effects proven by checkpoint-attributed immutable history. Scope attribution to the physical tracker and target item, capture it at the shared locked item writer, and check inverse-field postimages under that same lock. Failed/no-effect rows and repeated rollback must not fabricate restores. Legacy checkpoints without attribution will refuse safely and retain explicit manual history/restore recovery.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Compatibility hardening: newly written checkpoints now use schema2. A reader expecting schema1 refuses them before any restoration; new readers also refuse legacy timestamp-only artifacts with explicit history/restore review guidance. Separate controls cover current-schema checkpoints that lack attributed recovery semantics. This prevents an older CLI from silently using its destructive rollback on a new guarded checkpoint.

patch.value: Undo successful bulk effects while preserving later peer edits and truthful conflict/no-effect receipts across SDK and CLI.

Checkpoint schema2 binds committed target-item writes to immutable history; rollback verifies the live item and field postimages under the normal fenced mutation lock, reverses only those effects, preserves unrelated peer context, skips absent or already-reversed effects, and refuses legacy or drifted recovery without implicit force.

Three pre-fix controls failed at the intended loss/false-success boundaries. Final focused144 tests, linked20 tests, packed npm/Bun acceptance and strict typecheck pass. Full local coverage failures were repaired and rechecked; final hosted coverage remains mandatory before merge.
Implemented guarded bulk rollback with peer-context preservation and versioned recovery evidence
